film_grain — GFX2D post op

• Data kinds: rgb → rgb

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.film_grain(rgb, sigma=0.03, seed=0, monochrome=True) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import gfx2d; gfx2d.film_grain(rgb, sigma=0.03, seed=0, monochrome=True), registry से लेना हो तो opsgfx2d.get("film_grain"))

उपयोग

zero-mean Gaussian grain जोड़ता है, seed से deterministic रूप से।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

monochrome adds the same noise to all three channels (what film grain does — the silver halide crystal is not coloured); set it false for sensor read noise, which is per-channel.

sigma=0 returns the input bit for bit. The clip at [0, 1] biases the mean wherever the image is already near an end of the range; the suite measures the shift (2.4e-4 on a mid-grey image at sigma=0.03, 1.0e-4 on a half-black half-white one) rather than claiming it is zero.
